items.stem: Which TWO are good reasons to add a compound index? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A frequent query filters and sorts on the same two fields
options.rationale: Correct: compound indexes serve combined filter/sort patterns.

options.text: The field order matches the query's equality-then-range pattern
options.rationale: Correct: index prefix order should match query usage.

options.text: To store more copies of the data for backup
Because every field should always be indexed
